easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play Riveteers Overlook.
When Riveteers Overlook enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Riveteers Overlook.
Resolve the Riveteers Overlook trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it, search your library for an applicable land and put it onto the battlefield tapped, and gain 1 life.
Haru triggers, returning Riveteers Overlook from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
